info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Healthcare Appointments Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: The Cancel Healthcare Appointments API facilitates the cancellation of scheduled healthcare appointments through a streamlined process. This endpoint allows users, such as medical staff or patients, to manage their appointment schedules efficiently. By providing the necessary appointment identifiers, consumers can ensure timely cancellations, aiding in better resource allocation and availability. It is essential for health care applications that require real-time updates to appointment statuses to enhance user experience.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel a previously scheduled appointment. Ensure that the appointment ID is provided to successfully process the cancellation request.

requestBody.description: This request body should contain the necessary information to cancel an appointment. Ensure to provide all required fields as specified in the schema.
